description: Arithmetic on your own numbers: calls per week x missed % x close rate x average job value, per week, month and year, with every step and assumption shown. It is an estimate of the value of jobs at stake from missed calls, not a prediction of what any tool will recover. Also shows how many saved jobs a month would cover Ringback's price.

average_job_value.description: Average revenue per job, in US dollars.

calls_per_week.description: Inbound calls the business gets in a typical week.

close_rate_percent.description: Share of answered callers who normally book a job, in percent (e.g. 30).

missed_percent.description: Share of those calls that go unanswered, in percent (e.g. 25).

name: estimate_missed_call_cost
title: Estimate what missed calls cost a service business
